item.title: Mario Kart World Has Been Updated To Version 1.9.0, Here Are The Full Patch Notes

description.p: Knockout Tour updates, adjustments, fixes and more.Nintendo has rolled out a new update for its Switch 2 exclusive Mario Kart World this week. It bumps the title up to Version 1.9.0.According to the official patch notes, the Feather and Lucky Cat Rally have been added to Knockout Tour, and multiple courses have now be added to VS Race, Time Trials and races in online and wireless play. There are multiple other adjustments and fixes to improve the overall experience.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: The Reason Behind Pokémon's Mysterious Social Media Countdown Has Been Revealed

description.p: Update: Brace for disappointment.The Pokémon Company is no stranger to a little over-hyping every now and then, but its latest bit of marketing has us seriously thinking that there is a big announcement in the pipeline.You see, TPC is counting down to... something. As brought to our attention by Serebii's Joe Merrick, the company has been sharing images on social media of its 30th anniversary icons, with a number underneath. Interestingly, these numbers decrease by the number of hours that have passed between each post — 1,025 on 18th October, 843 on 26th, 676 today.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Pokémon Teams Up With Casetify On A New Line Of Phone Cases And Accessories

description.p: Launching next week.The Pokémon Company really is going all out with the collaborations for its 30th anniversary. Phone case brand Casetify is next in line for a crossover, as it has announced that its new collection of cases and accessories will be launching next week.The collection will go live on 1st December at 8am GMT / 9am CET / 3am ET, and will consist of "pixel-art Pokémon cases, charms and tech accessories, including returning icons and new special-edition designs," according to Casetify. There's even a waitlist you can sign up for online, so you know the very minute it drops.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Fantasy RPG 'Sovereign Tower' Brings Some Round Table Management To Switch Next Year

description.p: Knight's watch.Sovereign Tower launched on Steam earlier this year and quickly picked up its fair share of fans for its wacky round table management. Today, developer Wild Wits and publisher Curve Games have announced that we Switch fans will be able to get in on the fun in the new year.That's right, this one is coming to Switch on 14th January 2027. In it, you play as the sovereign of the titular tower, thrust into power after the untimely demise of your predecessor and tasked with keeping the kingdom up and running. To do so, you'll have to recruit knights and match their unique skills to tasks across the land — nabbing stolen manuscripts, taking down evil beings, negotiating with vampires, you know the drill.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Kirby And The World Beyond Details Revealed In Nintendo Catalogue

description.p: One of 2027's big-hitters.New details regarding Kirby and the World Beyond have been revealed via Nintendo's winter catalogue in Japan (via Genki_JPN on X). While hardly comprehensive, it provides a little more insight into the game's story along with the abilities and environments available upon its release.Of course, we know from the debut trailer that this will boast a much broader world than The Forgotten Land, with one detail noting how you can use Kirby's abilities to explore at your own pace. We also get a touch more context behind King Dedede's role, with the article stating that "a mysterious girl" has been kidnapped by the antagonist.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
